item.title: Uber's robotaxi edge: human drivers
item.description: Uber is investing billions in a driverless future, but the key to making the economics work could be its vast army of human drivers.

item.title: Trump's Board of Peace to present $2.45 billion Gaza recovery plan
item.description: President Trump's Board of Peace will present a six-month, $2.45 billion recovery plan for Gaza at a Wednesday meeting of its members.

item.title: The 'All-In' influence on Trump's AI agenda
item.description: President Trump's accelerationist AI doctrine increasingly reflects the "All-In" podcast, whose tech-investor network supplies ideas and talent.

item.title: Trump makes late push on voter fraud
item.description: The Trump administration says Americans should expect a wave of new arrests and prosecutions over alleged non-citizen voting before Election Day.
